deactivate.title: The confirmation before an admin deactivates a person: what stops working, what else ends, and what stays theirs. {{first}} is the person's first name.
deactivate.transferred: Toast after a transfer: {{from}} and {{to}} are people's names.
deactivate.keysStop: Bold start of the warning about service keys (API keys) the person made.
deactivate.lastKey: Badge: this is the service account's only working key, so the account {{account}} stops working too.
deactivate.keyUsed: {{ago}} is a lowercase time phrase ("25 min ago", "yesterday").
deactivate.ends.sessions: Lines of the "Also ends" list; each is followed by its outcome (deactivate.outcomes).
deactivate.ends.pluginAccess: Plugin sessions and the one-time codes that launch plugins.
deactivate.ends.roomsHandedOver: A Room is a group chat. {{first}} is the person's first name.
deactivate.outcomes.signedOut: What happens to each line of the "Also ends" list, in a short muted phrase.
deactivate.confirm: The deactivate button; the _only form when a new owner is chosen but the admin deactivates without transferring.
transfer.description: The dialog that hands what a person owns to another active person. {{first}} is the first name of the person it is taken from.
transfer.option: An option in the new-owner list: name and email.
transfer.nothingMoved: What moved of a kind, when nothing did.
transfer.withApps: Before the data space's description, when apps move too: their data has to move with them.
transfer.title: The _done form is the title after the transfer, with the new owner's name.
transfer.confirm: The confirm button with the new owner's first name; the _partial form when only some kinds are ticked.
confirm.typeName: The admin types the person's name exactly, to confirm. Keep the <strong> tags around {{name}}.
confirm.waiting: While a new one-time confirmation (step-up challenge) is fetched from the server.
makeOwner.title: Hands the workspace ownership to another admin. The owner is the one admin others can't demote, deactivate or remove.
makeOwner.withConfirm: The button on development servers, where no password or passkey is asked.
remove.title: Removes a person permanently, after a backup: a dry run first, then a typed name and a password or passkey.
remove.help.owned: Explains a reason the server gave for refusing the removal, in the admin's terms.
remove.records: A collapsed list of the database records the removal planner found for what they still own.
remove.rowsAcross: Database rows, across how many tables.
remove.deleted: {{rows}} and {{tables}} are counted phrases ("12 rows", "3 tables").
remove.backup: Where the backup was written. <code/> is replaced by the backup's path; keep it.
remove.cleanupFailed: {{error}} is the server's error message. <code/> is replaced by a command to run on the server; keep it.
remove.cleaned: {{files}} and {{objects}} are counted phrases; {{size}} is their total size ("3.4 MB").
remove.withConfirm: The button on development servers, where no password or passkey is asked.
